mapper.insert: INSERT INTO QUERY_REQUEST ( REQUEST_ID, REQUEST_NO, SOURCE_REQUEST_ID, DRAFTER_ID, DEPT_ID, TITLE, PURPOSE, DETAIL_CONTENT, IS_URGENT, DESIRED_DATE ) VALUES ( #{requestId}, #{requestNo}, #{sourceRequestId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{drafterId}, #{deptId}, #{title}, #{purpose, jdbcType=CLOB}, #{detailContent, jdbcType=CLOB}, #{isUrgent}, #{desiredDate, jdbcType=DATE} )

SELECT SEQ_QUERY_ITEM.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO QUERY_ITEM ( QUERY_ID, REQUEST_ID, QUERY_ORDER, QUERY_TITLE, SQL_TEXT, AUTHORING_TYPE, VALIDATION_STATUS ) VALUES ( #{queryId}, #{requestId}, #{queryOrder}, #{queryTitle}, #{sqlText, jdbcType=CLOB}, #{authoringType}, 'PENDING' )
mapper.select: SELECT R.REQUEST_ID, R.REQUEST_NO, R.SOURCE_REQUEST_ID, S.REQUEST_NO AS SOURCE_REQUEST_NO, R.TITLE, R.PURPOSE, R.DETAIL_CONTENT, R.IS_URGENT, R.DESIRED_DATE, U.USER_NAME AS DRAFTER_NAME, D.DEPT_NAME, R.REQUEST_CLASS, R.REQUEST_STATUS, R.APPROVAL_STATUS, R.CREATED_AT, R.SUBMITTED_AT FROM QUERY_REQUEST R JOIN USERS U ON U.USER_ID = R.DRAFTER_ID JOIN DEPARTMENT D ON D.DEPT_ID = R.DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN QUERY_REQUEST S ON S.REQUEST_ID = R.SOURCE_REQUEST_ID AND S.DRAFTER_ID = R.DRAFTER_ID WHERE R.REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} AND R.DRAFTER_ID = #{drafterId}

SELECT I.QUERY_ID, I.QUERY_ORDER, I.QUERY_TITLE, I.SQL_TEXT, I.AUTHORING_TYPE, I.VALIDATION_STATUS, I.ITEM_CLASS FROM QUERY_ITEM I JOIN QUERY_REQUEST R ON R.REQUEST_ID = I.REQUEST_ID WHERE R.REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} AND R.DRAFTER_ID = #{drafterId} ORDER BY I.QUERY_ORDER
mapper.update: UPDATE QUERY_REQUEST SET REQUEST_STATUS = 'PENDING_APPROVAL', APPROVAL_STATUS = 'PENDING', SUBMITTED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} AND DRAFTER_ID = #{drafterId} AND REQUEST_STATUS = 'DRAFT'
mapper.select:
SELECT R.REQUEST_ID, R.REQUEST_NO, R.TITLE, R.IS_URGENT, R.REQUEST_CLASS, R.REQUEST_STATUS, R.APPROVAL_STATUS, R.CREATED_AT, R.DESIRED_DATE, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM QUERY_ITEM I WHERE I.REQUEST_ID = R.REQUEST_ID ) AS SQL_COUNT FROM QUERY_REQUEST R
ORDER BY R.CREATED_AT DESC, R.REQUEST_ID DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_COUNT, COUNT(CASE WHEN REQUEST_STATUS = 'DRAFT' THEN 1 END) AS DRAFT_COUNT, COUNT(CASE WHEN REQUEST_STATUS = 'PENDING_APPROVAL' THEN 1 END) AS PENDING_APPROVAL_COUNT, COUNT(CASE WHEN REQUEST_STATUS = 'READY' THEN 1 END) AS READY_COUNT, COUNT(CASE WHEN REQUEST_STATUS = 'RUNNING' THEN 1 END) AS RUNNING_COUNT, COUNT(CASE WHEN REQUEST_STATUS = 'RETRY_REVIEW' THEN 1 END) AS RETRY_REVIEW_COUNT, COUNT(CASE WHEN REQUEST_STATUS = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 END) AS COMPLETED_COUNT, COUNT(CASE WHEN REQUEST_STATUS = 'PARTIAL_FAILED' THEN 1 END) AS PARTIAL_FAILED_COUNT, COUNT(CASE WHEN REQUEST_STATUS = 'FAILED' THEN 1 END) AS FAILED_COUNT, COUNT(CASE WHEN REQUEST_STATUS = 'REJECTED' THEN 1 END) AS REJECTED_COUNT, COUNT(CASE WHEN REQUEST_STATUS = 'WITHDRAWN' THEN 1 END) AS WITHDRAWN_COUNT FROM QUERY_REQUEST WHERE DRAFTER_ID = #{drafterId}

SELECT A.APPROVAL_ID, A.APPROVAL_ORDER, A.APPROVAL_TYPE, A.STATUS, A.APPROVER_ID, U.USER_NAME AS APPROVER_NAME, D.DEPT_NAME, P.POSITION_NAME FROM APPROVAL A JOIN QUERY_REQUEST Q ON Q.REQUEST_ID = A.REQUEST_ID LEFT JOIN USERS U ON U.USER_ID = A.APPROVER_ID LEFT JOIN DEPARTMENT D ON D.DEPT_ID = U.DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN POSITION P ON P.POSITION_ID = U.POSITION_ID WHERE A.REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} AND Q.DRAFTER_ID = #{drafterId} ORDER BY A.APPROVAL_ORDER, A.APPROVAL_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO QUERY_RESOURCE_USAGE ( QUERY_ID, RESOURCE_ID, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{queryId}, #{resourceId}, SYSTIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE QUERY_REQUEST R SET REQUEST_STATUS = 'WITHDRAWN', APPROVAL_STATUS = 'CANCELLED' WHERE R.REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} AND R.DRAFTER_ID = #{drafterId} AND R.REQUEST_STATUS = 'PENDING_APPROVAL' AND R.APPROVAL_STATUS = 'PENDING' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM USERS U WHERE U.USER_ID = #{drafterId} AND U.ENABLED = 'Y' ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM APPROVAL A WHERE A.REQUEST_ID = R.REQUEST_ID AND A.STATUS = 'PENDING' ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM APPROVAL A WHERE A.REQUEST_ID = R.REQUEST_ID AND ( NVL(A.STATUS, 'UNKNOWN') NOT IN ('PENDING', 'WAITING') OR A.DECIDED_AT IS NOT NULL ) )
UPDATE APPROVAL SET STATUS = 'CANCELLED', COMMENT_TEXT = '작성자의 기안서 회수로 결재가 종료되었습니다.', DECIDED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} AND STATUS IN ('PENDING', 'WAITING')
